commandThesis.thesisStatement: Atlas Group faces a severe logistics margin compression. The immediate priority is cash preservation and suspension of inorganic expansion.
commandThesis.orchestrationNarrative: The correlation between rising logistics costs and debt cost indicates an imminent rupture if expansion is maintained.

directives.title: Suspension of Inorganic Expansion
directives.statement: Immediate freeze of all planned acquisitions for the next semester due to liquidity pressure.

directives.title: Dividend Retention
directives.statement: Limit dividend distribution to the mandatory legal minimum this fiscal year.

alignment.narrative: Commercial growth posture diverges from the current treasury need to protect cash.

drift.description: Ad-hoc credit contracting by the Northern branch is not aligned with the deleveraging directive.

explainability.rationale: The cognitive engine detected that the debt service cost will exceed operational cash generation in 4 months if the logistics margin maintains its current degradation.
